name: daily-picture
description: AI-generated daily images (history, insects, dogs) for physical displays

scripts.install:daily: npm --prefix sites/daily install && npm --prefix sites/daily/frontend install && npm --prefix sites/daily/amplify install && npm --prefix sites/daily/amplify/functions/display-api install && npm --prefix sites/daily/amplify/functions/generate-daily-image install
scripts.install:insect: npm --prefix sites/insect install && npm --prefix sites/insect/frontend install && npm --prefix sites/insect/amplify install && npm --prefix sites/insect/amplify/functions/display-api install && npm --prefix sites/insect/amplify/functions/generate-daily-insect install
scripts.install:dog: npm --prefix sites/dog install && npm --prefix sites/dog/frontend install && npm --prefix sites/dog/amplify install && npm --prefix sites/dog/amplify/functions/display-api install && npm --prefix sites/dog/amplify/functions/generate-daily-dog install
scripts.install:nerd: npm --prefix sites/nerd install && npm --prefix sites/nerd/frontend install && npm --prefix sites/nerd/amplify install && npm --prefix sites/nerd/amplify/functions/display-api install && npm --prefix sites/nerd/amplify/functions/generate-daily-nerd install
scripts.install:all: npm run install:daily && npm run install:insect && npm run install:dog && npm run install:nerd
